title: Entry Level Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive Entry Level

£25,000 Basic Salary + Uncapped Commission OTE £50,000+ NR2

Location: NR2 Fully Office Based
Salary: £25,000 Basic + Uncapped Commission

Are you looking to get into sales but don't have the experience? No problem! We're looking for an ambitious, confident and motivated individual to join a growing sales team as an Entry Level Internal Sales Executive.

Full training will be provided, so this is a fantastic opportunity to learn a new industry, develop your sales skills and build a rewarding career with excellent earning potential.

The Role

This is a proactive, business-to-business sales role, focused on generating new business and developing opportunities through outbound calling.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Making high-volume outbound calls to local businesses.
- Cold calling prospective customers and generating new leads.
- Identifying potential sales opportunities and building relationships.
- Promoting products and services to business customers.
- Working towards sales targets and maximising commission opportunities.
- Developing your knowledge of the industry with full training and support.

What's on Offer?
- £25,000 basic annual salary.
- Uncapped commission the more you sell, the more you earn!
- £50,000+ OTE potential once fully trained, with existing team members already earning above this.
- Full training provided no previous sales experience required.
- Fantastic career progression opportunities.
- 22 days annual leave plus your birthday off (if it falls on a working day).
- An additional day of annual leave per year of service, up to 25 days.
- Additional incentives for punctuality and attendance.
- The opportunity to develop a long-term career in sales.

What We're Looking For

You don't need previous sales experience, but you do need the right attitude!

We're looking for someone who:
- Is confident, outgoing and comfortable speaking to new people.
- Isn't afraid to pick up the phone and make cold calls.
- Is motivated by money, targets and uncapped earning potential.
- Has a proactive approach to generating new business.
- Is resilient, determined and able to handle rejection.
- Wants to learn, develop and progress within a sales environment.

Please note: This is a fully office-based, high-volume outbound calling role. You will be making regular cold calls to businesses within the local area, so confidence on the telephone and a genuine appetite for sales are essential.

Interested?

If you're ready to get your foot in the door, learn a new industry and potentially earn £50k+, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Internal Sales Representative
description:
Internal Sales Represenative Telecommunications

£27,000 £28,000 Basic Salary + Uncapped Commission £50,000 OTE NR1 3 BG

Location: NR1 3 BG Fully Office Based
Salary: £27,000 £28,000 per annum + Uncapped Commission

Are you an experienced salesperson looking for your next opportunity within the exciting and ever-evolving telecommunications industry?

We're looking for a confident, commercially minded Internal Sales Executive to join an established business, selling a range of B2 B telecommunications and technology solutions.

You'll be working with business customers, selling solutions including Cloud Services, AI, Telephone Systems, Business Mobiles and Data Solutions.

This is a varied sales role combining new business development, account management, contract renewals and upselling, offering fantastic earning potential and the opportunity to grow your career.

The Role

You'll be responsible for developing and maintaining a portfolio of business customers, maximising revenue opportunities and identifying opportunities to introduce additional services.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Making outbound calls to prospective business customers to generate new opportunities.
- Managing and developing existing business accounts.
- Handling account renewals and managing existing customer contracts.
- Identifying upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the product portfolio.
- Promoting Cloud, AI, Telephone Lines, Business Mobiles and Data Solutions.
- Building relationships with business owners and key decision-makers.
- Negotiating with customers and confidently closing sales.
- Maintaining accurate records and working towards sales and performance targets.

What's on Offer?
- £27,000 £28,000 basic annual salary, depending on experience.
- Uncapped commission with an OTE of £50,000 once your desk is established.
- Two-yearly performance and salary reviews.
- Salary reviews will assess your overall performance, attendance and key business statistics, with salary increases available for employees who successfully meet the review criteria.
- Full training provided on the company's products, services and systems.
- Excellent opportunity to develop within the telecommunications industry.
- 22 days annual leave plus your birthday off (if it falls on a working day).
- An additional day of annual leave per year of service, up to 25 days.
- Additional incentives for punctuality and attendance.

What We're Looking For

We're ideally looking for someone with previous sales experience who is confident generating business, managing customer relationships and closing deals.

Relevant backgrounds could include:
- Business Development Executive / Manager.
- Account Manager / Account Executive.
- Internal Sales Executive.
- Telesales Executive.
- Sales Consultant.
- B2 B or B2 C Sales.

Ideally, you'll have experience in:
- Making outbound calls and cold calling.
- Generating new business opportunities.
- Closing sales and negotiating with customers.
- Managing existing accounts and customer relationships.
- Renewing contracts and identifying additional revenue opportunities.

Telecommunications experience would be advantageous but isn't essential, as full product and industry training will be provided.

We're looking for someone commercially driven, confident on the telephone, resilient and motivated by achieving targets and maximising their earning potential.

Interested?

If you're an experienced salesperson looking for a new challenge, fantastic commission potential and the opportunity to develop within the telecommunications sector, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Customer Service Representative

Location: Norwich, NR3
Salary: £12.71ph
Job Type: Full-time / Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Customer Service Representative to join a busy team within the insurance sector.

The successful candidate will have previous insurance sales experience, excellent communication skills and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service. You will support customers with their insurance needs, ensuring a professional, efficient and accurate service at all times.

Key Responsibilities
- Handle customer enquiries via telephone, email and written correspondence.
- Process new business, renewals, cancellations and mid-term adjustments.
- Understand customer needs and recommend suitable insurance products.
- Underwrite policies within delegated authority, referring complex cases where necessary.
- Manage renewal and new business opportunities to help secure and retain customers.
- Handle customer objections, queries and complaints professionally.
- Process customer payments and maintain accurate records.
- Ensure compliance with FCA regulations and Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) principles.
- Work collaboratively to achieve team targets and objectives.

About You

Essential:
- Minimum of one year's general insurance sales experience.
- GCSE Maths and English at Grade 4 9 (or equivalent).
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Professional telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Good IT skills and accurate record-keeping abilities.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Effective problem-solving skills and ability to meet deadlines.

Desirable:
- Level 3 Certificate in Insurance (or working towards).
- Knowledge of FCA regulations and financial services compliance.
- Experience or knowledge of property insurance products.

If you are an enthusiastic and customer-focused individual looking to develop your career within the insurance industry, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV and details of your relevant experience.
